reason: I only really need filtered water a few times a year when I travel, so a filter subscription makes no sense for me, and buying the bottle alone means $49.99 plus $12.99 shipping, which is basically $63 for a water bottle. A 5% code doesn't come close to fixing that.
objection: It's another subscription I'll forget to cancel, paying for filters that expire on a 2-month clock while the bottle sits in my cupboard between trips. And $12.99 shipping on a bottle with no plan feels like a penalty to push me into the subscription.
would_change_my_mind: Free shipping on the bottle by itself with no plan, around $35-40 total, plus the option to buy single spare filters whenever I want instead of on a schedule.
